optimizedContext.value:
# Schema Format

## Rules
- Top-level requires `kind: schema|schema-plugin`, `name`, integer `version`; full schema requires `artifacts`, may declare description/extends/compat/cross validations/workflow. Plugins forbid artifacts/workflow/extends/compat/metadataExtraction; may contribute documented merge operations. Unknown top-level fields ignored. Zod + semantic validation precede domain construction.
- `compat`: string or `{name, version?}`; omitted version=1. `Schema.compat()` returns identity; `Schema.canonicalSpecSchema()` prefers compat, then parsed extends, then own name/version. Extends resolves recursively root→leaf, inherits compat unless child overrides, detects path cycles.
- Artifact IDs match `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`; hook/validation/rule/cleanup/cross-validation/extraction IDs match `/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/`, length 1–64. Hooks globally unique across workflow; other IDs unique immediate array; workflow identity=`step`, participant identity=`as`.
- Artifact fields: required id/scope `spec|change`/output; optional description/template/instruction/requires/format/optional/hasTasks/delta/deltaInstruction/deltaValidations/validations/metadataExtraction/rules/preHashCleanup/taskCompletionCheck. `optional`/`hasTasks`/`delta` default false. Delta only spec scope. Output filename uses final literal glob segment, then template filename, else validation error.
- `scope: spec` syncs to repository/archive; `scope: change` remains working document. Non-optional artifacts required in change; non-optional spec artifacts required in persisted specs.
- `Schema.artifactDag()` is cached canonical requires graph: `roots`, `childrenOf`, `parentsOf`, stable `topologicalOrder`, stable `descendantsOf`. All production DAG consumers use it; no local graph rebuild/declaration-order proxy. Requires known IDs, acyclic; non-optional cannot depend on optional.
- `preHashCleanup` applies ordered regex substitutions before validated and approval hashes. `hasTasks:true` enables task capability; task patterns default Markdown checkboxes. `workflow.requiresTaskCompletion` may reference only hasTasks artifacts.
- Base validations select by selector XOR RFC 9535 JSONPath, then optional zero-match `required`, `count`, `contentMatches`, nested `children`. Count handles cardinality/unique keys. Delta validations use same model against normalized delta YAML AST and require delta=true.
- Cross-artifact validation participants are same-scope artifact aliases with selector/key extraction; relations `all-equal|subset|superset`; optional ordering ignore|strict. Compare extracted keys, not raw AST.
- Metadata extraction maps fields to artifact selectors/extract/capture/strip/groupBy/transform/fields; `dependsOn` captures label/href; transform normalization failures explicit.
- Workflow rows attach extras to existing `ChangeState`: step, optional artifact requires, task-completion requires, pre/post hooks. Declaration order controls display and known-state axis; missing delivery states are fallback-spliced. Rows never define/remove states or impose adjacency; unknown/duplicate steps rejected.
- Hook entry: id + exactly one `instruction`, `run`, or `external:{type,config}`. Unknown external runner type rejected after merged registry resolution.
- Templates resolve relative to schema; loaded eagerly; plain text preserved. Rules pre/post wrap instruction. Format inferred from output extension when omitted.
- References: `@scope/name` npm; `#workspace:name`; `#name`/bare default workspace; relative/absolute path direct. Missing file returns null; caller throws `SchemaNotFoundError`.
- `verify.md` mirrors `### Requirement:` headings and contains informative WHEN/THEN scenarios; verify artifact normally requires spec.

## Constraints
- Every schema declares kind; plugin forbidden fields rejected.
- Duplicate/invalid IDs, unknown requires, cycles, invalid task references, invalid delta settings, duplicate/unknown workflow steps → `SchemaValidationError`.
- Optional dependency propagates optionality.
- Delta format/selectors/application remain defined by core:delta-format.
